name: Milk and Cream
gmNotes: Tutorial Side Mission for Mission Trackers, stealth/fail-forward play, domestic offerings, and the distinction between physical payment and Grace. It may be completed before or after Iron and Wax. Coinín conceals the true destination of the food without making a false assertion.
briefing: Coinín wants the cream and milk promised for his silence. Cross the watched palisade after dark, gather what the villagers have left outside their doors, and bring it back without turning the whole village against you.
objective: Collect ten méisrin of cream and five olderb of milk, then deliver them to Coinín.
debriefing: The cream and milk are in Coinín's hands, and Trí Mhuilinn sleeps on—more or less. Only the honey remains, unless Buaic's errand has already supplied it.

storyBeats.title: Coinín's Instructions
storyBeats.events: Coinín explains that villagers leave milk and cream outside for household spirits. He wants the promised quantities collected during the night and returned to him. Méabh understands the collection as a supply route; the player is likely to understand it as taking neighbours' offerings.
storyBeats.objective: Learn what must be collected and where to find it.
storyBeats.gmInstructions: Keep Coinín literally truthful but strategically incomplete. He does not claim he can consume the food and does not reveal the Takeling/clone supply chain. Use the existing Grace and Bargain rules to explain that the goods discharge part of an obligation; do not invent a numeric Grace reward.

storyBeats.title: The Watched Palisade
storyBeats.events: Recent thefts have changed the village routine. One watchman guards the palisade gate while another patrols inside. The team must choose whether to sneak, bluff, use a familiar route, create a distraction, or explain themselves.
storyBeats.objective: Enter the village without alarming the watch.
storyBeats.gmInstructions: Make the watchmen alert rather than murderous. A failed approach may cost Concealment or Composure, create suspicion, require a favour, split the route, or force a new plan. It must not prevent collection or turn the Mission into combat.

storyBeats.title: Bowls at the Thresholds
storyBeats.events: Bowls, pots, and covered vessels sit at selected thresholds. Some are easy to reach; others lie near dogs, wakeful families, creaking gates, iron charms, or the patrol's route. Update the two Mission Trackers immediately as measures are secured.
storyBeats.objective: Gather the promised milk and cream from sleeping households.
storyBeats.gmInstructions: Offer several small problems and let player choices determine which houses they risk. Do not roll for every vessel. Use checks only where discovery or loss is meaningfully at stake. On failure, spill or lose some progress, attract attention, create a social consequence, or demand a different route; always leave enough opportunities to reach both targets.

storyBeats.title: Payment in Milk
storyBeats.events: The team returns to Coinín with ten méisrin of cream and five olderb of milk. He checks the quantities with professional exactness and acknowledges that those portions of the promised payment have been delivered. Two méisrin of honey remain due unless Iron and Wax was completed first.
storyBeats.objective: Deliver the collected goods and record what remains owed.
storyBeats.gmInstructions: Keep both tracker values at target as historical Mission-object progress once delivery is complete; these counters record the objective, not carried inventory. Update Coinín's Silence to record delivery of the cream and milk. Resolve the accepting party's combined obligation only if the honey was already delivered through Iron and Wax. Coinín's nondisclosure obligation remains active.

description: Milk and cream wait outside sleeping homes, but recent thefts have put Trí Mhuilinn's watchmen on edge. Collecting the offerings without waking the village will teach what the Good People regard as payment—and what humans call stealing.
completionEffects: Record the cream and milk as delivered under Coinín's Silence. If Iron and Wax has already delivered the two méisrin of honey, mark the accepting party's joint goods obligation resolved; otherwise leave it unresolved. Coinín's promise not to tell Morrigan remains an active obligation. Do not advance the moon phase.
